📺 Resident Alien (2021–2025)

Resident Alien follows Harry Vanderspeigle, a mysterious extraterrestrial who crash-lands on Earth and assumes the identity of a small-town doctor in Patience, Colorado. Originally sent on a secret mission to destroy humanity, Harry finds his plans unexpectedly complicated when he becomes involved in a local murder investigation and is forced to interact with the town’s unusual residents. Despite possessing extraordinary intelligence and advanced alien abilities, Harry struggles to understand human emotions, friendships, relationships, and everyday social behavior, leading to countless hilarious misunderstandings and awkward situations. Things become even more complicated when a young boy named Max discovers Harry’s true identity, threatening to expose his carefully hidden secret. As Harry develops unexpected friendships with nurse Asta Twelvetrees and other members of the community, he begins questioning his mission and discovering what it truly means to be human. Starring Alan Tudyk, Sara Tomko, Corey Reynolds, Alice Wetterlund, and Levi Fiehler, the series combines hilarious comedy, science-fiction mysteries, thrilling adventures, and heartfelt storytelling about friendship, identity, belonging, and the unexpected beauty of humanity.

🎭 Genre: Science Fiction • Comedy • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43–60 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Developer: Chris Sheridan

📺 Seasons: 4 • 44 Episodes

📚 Based On: The Resident Alien comic book series created by Peter Hogan and Steve Parkhouse, published by Dark Horse Comics.

🏆 Recognition: Praised for Alan Tudyk’s comedic performance, imaginative storytelling, and unique combination of science fiction and humor.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Peacock and Netflix for current streaming availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Resident Alien is an American science fiction comedy-drama television series created by Chris Sheridan, based on the comic book by Peter Hogan and Steve Parkhouse, that aired for four seasons from January 2021 to August 2025 on Syfy. It stars Alan Tudyk in the title role as an extraterrestrial who crash-lands on Earth with the intent to destroy the planet but develops a moral dilemma. In July 2025, it was confirmed that the fourth season would be its last.
